title: Two Giveaway Posts
intro: Two posts offer a free phone, both using Kiko's name. One is Kiko. One is Mirage in a creator's hoodie.
decide_q: Which post is really from Kiko, and what will you do?

screen.context: Both posts say Kiko is giving away a phone. Kiko's own website lists @kiko as the real account.

v.text: Live, in a public video, on Friday

note.text: Pinned: "Beware of copy accounts. We never DM winners asking for money."

v.text: Send us a DM with your details and €5 delivery

note.text: No pinned notices. Comments are turned off.

acct_b.label: A copy of the real name
acct_b.why: Copy accounts add words to a real name.

age_b.label: Brand-new account
age_b.why: A new account with a famous name is a copy.

how_b.label: Enter by DM and pay
how_b.lens: You must DM your details and pay delivery.
how_b.why: A real giveaway is entered in public and costs nothing.

cost_b.label: Costs money
cost_b.why: A free prize that costs money is a scam.

pick_b.label: Everyone wins, pay fast
pick_b.why: If everyone wins, it is not a contest. It is bait.

pin_b.label: Comments turned off
pin_b.lens: No pinned notice, and nobody can ask questions.
pin_b.why: Scammers turn off comments so doubters cannot warn others.

acct_a.label: Real handle
acct_a.lens: @kiko matches the handle on Kiko's own website.
acct_a.why: A handle matching the official site is good evidence.

age_a.label: Old, large account
age_a.why: Age and followers alone can be faked, but a long history helps.

how_a.label: Comment in public
how_a.lens: You enter in a public post.
how_a.why: Public entry is how real giveaways work.

pick_a.label: Public live draw
pick_a.lens: The winner is chosen live, in public.

pin_a.label: Warns about copies
pin_a.lens: The creator warns against copy accounts and money requests.

actions.label: B is Kiko. DM and pay €5
Not sure. Check Kiko's own website
A is Kiko. Report B as a copy

trap.title: Kiko Giveaways · Pay
trap.ask: Pay €5 delivery and enter your card number.

block_report.line: You entered the real giveaway for free and reported the copy. The fake was removed.

verify.line: Kiko's own website listed @kiko as the real account and warned about copies. Case cracked.

pick_b.line: The €5 page copied your card. No phone ever came.

what_if.pick_b: Account B had five warnings: a copied name, a new account, a DM entry, a fee and comments turned off.
what_if.verify: Checking was smart. Reporting B as well helps get the copy removed.

golden_rule: A real giveaway is entered in public, costs nothing and is drawn in public. A copy hides, asks for money and rushes.

quick_check.q: Two giveaway posts. One draws live in public and is free. One needs a DM and a fee. Which is the copy?
quick_check.explain: A fee and a private DM are the giveaways of a scam.

hints.nudge: Which account is new, asks for money and has comments off?
